title: Vmux development workspace to locally installed notarized macOS app
description: A Tauri and React desktop service-control project needed to move from a development workspace to a locally installed macOS application without creating any external release. The result had to include a real production build, native tests, signing and notarization checks, and a recoverable replacement of the previously installed app.

items: A Tauri 2, React, TypeScript, and Vite desktop project with its existing local application bundle not running.
A request to install the current verified changes locally while keeping external publication out of scope.

prompt: Install the current Vmux build into local Applications, verify the production artifact, and do not publish it externally.

items: A version 0.1.1 macOS application bundle created by the Tauri production build.
Eighteen native tests passed; the bundle passed codesign, Gatekeeper, and notarization stapling checks.
The installed executable digest matched the staged production bundle, while the previous local application was retained in a recoverable location.
